name: Do soft close drawers require any special maintenance?

mainEntity.name: Do soft close drawers require any special maintenance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Soft close drawer slides are designed for durability and generally require minimal special maintenance. Periodically, you can wipe them clean with a damp cloth to remove dust or debris, ensuring smooth operation. Avoid using harsh chemical cleaners, as they can damage the finish or lubricants. If a slide becomes stiff over time, a small amount of silicone spray lubricant can be applied sparingly, though this is rarely needed for quality slides.
acceptedAnswer.description: Soft close drawers require minimal maintenance; periodic cleaning with a damp cloth is usually sufficient.
